name: Ruin Ember
description: Throw a dark red ember that sets alight whatever it strikes and cannot be beaten out by hand.

name: Scorched Footing
description: Scorch the ground under a foe so that every step burns and the stance cannot hold.

name: Charring Veil
description: Hold a black veil of charring heat that eats thrown weapons before they arrive.

name: Ash Sense
description: Read the drifting ash of an old fire to find the heat that is still hidden in it.

name: Pyre Collapse
description: Let a towering pyre fall in on itself and throw its burning mass outward over a wide ring.

name: Raging Curtain
description: Hang a raging curtain of fire round the user that guards the body and burns all that press in.

name: Searing Pillar
description: Drive a white pillar of fire through the target and the ground behind it.

name: Scouring Breath
description: Breathe out a scouring wave of fire that strips cloth and paint and skin from all in front.

name: Furnace Heart
description: Turn the chest into a furnace that feeds every fire move with heat beyond the reserve's usual measure.

name: Annihilating Pyre
description: Loose a flare so bright and hot that it burns the cloth and hair of everything in its light.

name: Pyre Unbound
description: Let a pyre loose from every limit of shape and spread it as far as the field will reach.

name: Cinder Crown
description: Raise a crown of burning cinders over a great ring and bring it down in a single rain of fire.

name: Ruinfire Descent
description: Call down a sea of ruin-fire to the full destructive ceiling of a Xiantian field and leave nothing living standing in it.

name: Coreflame Spark
description: Throw a spark drawn straight from the Core that burns many times hotter than its size.

name: Coal Heart
description: Set a coal of Core heat before the heart that turns a killing blow into a burn.

name: Furnace Pulse
description: Send a pulse of Core heat through the ground that breaks the footing and the rhythm of foes.

name: Core Warmth
description: Share the warmth of the Core with an ally and restore strength to a spent body.

name: Core Combustion
description: Ignite the target's own qi with a fine jet of Core fire so that it burns from the inside.

name: Core Shroud
description: Wrap the whole body in a shroud of Core fire that no common weapon can pass.

name: Spiral Crucible
description: Turn the ground round the user into a spiral crucible that melts everything flowing into it.

name: Purging Core
description: Burn deep taint or curse from an ally's body with a steady flame fed from the Core.

name: Heartfire Burst
description: Burst the heat stored round the heart outward in a ring that scorches the ground bare.

name: Coreglow Mantle
description: Make the Core shine through the skin so that allies near the light are warmed and guarded.

name: Sheet Flare
description: Loosen the bonds of the Core and let its heat pour out in a wide uncontrolled sheet.

name: Immolation Seal
description: Burn a seal into the ground that holds in everything within it and then bursts into fire.

name: Coreburn Ruin
description: Spend the heat of the Core in a single ruin that scorches the full destructive ceiling of a formed Core's reach.

name: Consuming Heart
description: Burn the user's own heart-fire into the target and the ground round it at the full destructive ceiling of a Core.

name: Divine Cinder
description: Throw a cinder of divine fire that keeps burning on stone and steel alike.

name: Sacred Warmth
description: Lay a steady divine warmth on an ally to lift weariness and ease deep wounds.

name: Pyrelit Veil
description: Raise a veil of divine flame that burns away the first strike aimed at the user.

name: Pyre Sight
description: See by the glow of a divine pyre the heat of every living being in view.

name: Judging Flame
description: Drive a thin flame through lie and guard alike to burn the heart of the one who is judged.

name: Pyre Aegis
description: Stand within a ring of divine pyre-fire that turns back every blow of the common world.

name: Absolving Flame
description: Burn the deepest taint or binding from an ally and leave the body clean.

name: Ember Resurgence
description: Restart the stopped breath and pulse of an ally at the edge of death with one great surge of divine heat.

name: Seraphic Blaze
description: Spread wings of divine fire wide and sweep the whole near ground with their burning edge.

name: Crowned Pyre
description: Wear a crown of divine fire that guards the user and burns all who come near.

name: Judgment Torrent
description: Pour a torrent of divine fire that burns the guilty and spares the ones the user shields.

name: Ageless Pyre
description: Hold a divine pyre alight for ages beyond counting and let its heat press out in every direction.

name: Divine Furnace
description: Make the body a divine furnace that raises allies' strength and burns foes within its glow.

name: Final Pyre
description: Raise the last pyre at the full destructive ceiling of the Divine realm and burn everything in its reach to ash.

name: Ash Judgment
description: Pass one verdict of fire over the whole range of the realm and reduce what it finds to ash.
